components.title: mgu-styles2
components.description: Four instrument clusters drawn over the whole iDrive 7 cluster: Toro (Lamborghini Huracan), M Sport (BMW M View), M Sport Plus (M stripes, a wide picture in the centre) and M Track Mode (BMW M's track view: four gauge rows, the gear, a leaning rev counter). The phone's map, BMW's own map or Turn View's camera in each. Off until you turn it on.
